name: Axio Hub Starter
description:
The perfect entry point for individuals building a personal second brain.

Intelligence: Access to Axio Fast (Speed-optimized model).

Storage: Upload up to 50 Files (100MB Total).

Features: Semantic Search, Chat History, Secure Workspace.

Best For: Students, Researchers, Hobbyists.

name: Axio Hub Pro
description:
For professionals and teams requiring deep analysis and larger capacity.

Intelligence: Unlocks Axio Pro (Reasoning model) + Axio Fast.

Storage: Massive capacity of 2,000 Files (10GB Total).

Features:

Web Crawling: Chat with live websites.

Deep Reasoning: Ask "Why?" and "How?", not just "What?".

Team Collaboration: Shared workspaces with role management.

Best For: SMEs, Consultants, Legal & Engineering Teams.
